jobs.description:
About the Role

At Amazon, we're looking for experienced Software Development Engineers (SDE III) who are passionate about solving complex technical challenges and building innovative, scalable solutions that impact millions of customers worldwide. As part of Amazon's engineering organization, you'll work on the latest technologies, collaborate with world-class engineers, and develop products and services that power one of the world's most customer-centric companies.

Our engineers solve some of the most challenging technical problems at global scale—designing highly available distributed systems, driving architectural innovation, and delivering exceptional customer experiences. Amazon's culture of Customer Obsession, Ownership, Invent and Simplify, and Learn and Be Curious empowers engineers to innovate, take bold decisions, and make a lasting impact.

We are actively hiring Software Development Engineer III (SDE III) talent across multiple Amazon businesses in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurgaon, and Chennai.

As we continue to innovate and scale our products and services, we're looking for engineers who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving ambiguous problems, and are excited to build technology that serves millions of customers globally.

Role Overview

As a Software Development Engineer III, you will:

Design and build highly scalable, reliable, and distributed software systems.
Own end-to-end technical solutions, from architecture and design through development, deployment, and operational excellence.
Partner with senior engineers, principal engineers, and technical leaders to solve complex engineering challenges.
Collaborate with product managers, cross-functional teams, and customers to build innovative, customer-centric solutions.
Drive technical excellence while contributing to the long-term architectural vision of the organization.
Mentor engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software solutions using modern technologies.
Lead architectural discussions and influence technical strategy.
Build highly available and performant distributed systems.
Collaborate across engineering, product, and business teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
Continuously improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.
Mentor junior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance.
Champion engineering best practices, quality, automation, and operational excellence.

jobs.description:
Have you ever wanted to be part of a team that builds highly efficient system for E-reader?
Are you looking at creating value for millions of customers as we launch more E-readers with additional capabilities? Do you want to work at a company where you are the owner, where you are encouraged to build, and where you have the autonomy to push boundaries? Do you have a passion for designing system that is an enabler for builders that create applications on top of it? This describes your daily journey. Are you ready? Then join us!

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer, you will own adding capabilities as we unlock more features on Kindle E-reader family. Our goal is to make it fast, easy and low-cost for our internal application developers to build features and release them on our E-reader stack.
You will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams across Amazon.
You should be comfortable with a level of depth that you need to dive into as we solve deep operating system level problems! We will need to tackle problems that span a variety of domains: software, hardware as well as automation.
You design and develop the critical components in the operating system as well as low-level components in E-reader that make the product a performant, secure and power optimized device. You also write applications on top of our unique Kindle Operating system.
Along the way you’ll learn a ton, have fun and make a positive impact on millions of people.
• You are proficient in C/C++ to understand internals of E-reader. If you know React Native, it will be a bonus as you can also write applications in E-reader.
• Collaborate with experienced Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative components in E-reader
• Architect and design a secure software that protects customer data stored on the devices.


A day in the life
In this role, you will be actively engaged in developing our system and writing applications that are based on C/C++ and react native. You will also be a lead engineer guiding junior members in this role.

jobs.description:
We're seeking a Software Development Manager to lead an engineering team within Amazon's Center of Excellence for Orchestration (ORCA). This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of Amazon's tier-1, multi-tenant orchestration platform that powers mission-critical business workflows across Amazon's diverse ecosystem, from Retail to Digital Services and beyond.

ORCA is built on HERD and serves as the backbone for implementing complex business processes through workflow automation. As a tier-1 service, it delivers operational excellence with automated scaling, throttling, and retry mechanisms, handling peak loads without customer intervention. The platform handles the complexity of orchestration (execution, monitoring, and fault tolerance) so developers can focus on designing business workflows. It supports synchronous request-response, asynchronous execution, time-based scheduling, and event-driven triggers while seamlessly integrating with AWS services and SDO solutions like Datapath and Sable.

You'll drive technical excellence by establishing roadmaps and ensuring operational reliability across the platform. Your team will build robust, scalable solutions that maintain high availability for Amazon's most critical business operations. The ideal candidate brings strong technical leadership in distributed systems and workflow orchestration, with exceptional system design skills and a proven track record in engineering management. You'll collaborate with product management, architecture teams, and business stakeholders while maintaining focus on engineering excellence and operational reliability.
